title: Suggestions for review — choose a path before anything is implemented
workflow: 1) Reviewer reads a suggestion with its options and evidence. 2) Reviewer picks option A/B/C (or rejects). 3) The chosen path is logged in this file's 'verdict' field and only then implemented by a session. NOTHING here has been implemented; status stays 'proposed' until a verdict exists.

rows.title: Decide how market prices will be obtained (or accept permanent blanks)
rows.context: Every market column, G7, real ROI and rewards are blocked by the absence of an official price source (Q01, FB-01).

options.text: License a historical + live odds archive (cost: money; unblocks G7, R4, real staking)
Keep market columns permanently blank and run the project price-independent only (free; honest; rewards stay 0)
Record manual third-party screenshots as 'observed non-official' prices, labelled everywhere (free; weaker evidence)

rows.evidence: nfl.com publishes no lines (verified across standings/scores pages this session and by every prior session)
rows.cost: A: paid / B: free / C: free
rows.risk: A: cost + licence terms; B: no edge measurement ever; C: evidence quality disputes
rows.recommendation: B now (keeps every published number verifiable), revisit A if the project is funded
